🏓 PingPong

A faithful browser recreation of table tennis — two paddles, one ball, fast reflexes. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Player 1 uses W/S keys, Player 2 uses Arrow Up/Down.
  2. Return the ball by positioning your paddle — angle matters for placement.
  3. The ball speeds up slightly after each hit, increasing pressure.
  4. Aim for the edges and corners to make returns harder.
  5. On mobile, drag your paddle left and right.
